input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by scrubber-1-v8 from the CO2 decay, V = Qe * tau, with the Lab occupant as the CO2 source.

monitoring.reason: FE-1 is the only occupant of the Lab, the volume whose CO2 is raised by the test; the hatch stays closed so Hab-B occupants are not exposed.

steps.why: Rise: reduced scrubber flow (Qe about 0.3 m3/min) moves the equilibrium up so the curve leaves the full-speed equilibrium; speed never below the 30 percent floor and the scrubber is never stopped.
Decay: full speed (Qe 1 m3/min); record the decay towards its equilibrium and fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau) for about one time constant (first guess tau = 30 m3 / 1 m3/min = 30 min).

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
battery state of charge under 40 percent
FE-1 out of the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring lost, or one more person entering the Lab

expected.rise: Only if the Lab's single occupant (0.38 L/min awake, about 12.7 ppm/min in a guessed 30 m3) and any Hab-B exchange exceed the scrubber's removal at 30 percent (0.3 m3/min * C), CO2 rises; with a source of 0.38 L/min alone the 30 percent equilibrium is about 1270 ppm, below the 1900 start, so a slow fall of a few ppm/min is also possible. Either way the trend must be smooth, monotonic and well above sensor noise. The test stays under 3000 ppm.
expected.decay: At full speed the CO2 falls smoothly towards an equilibrium (about 380 ppm if the occupant is the only source and there is no exchange), with tau near 30 min if V is near the default 30 m3; the fit gives V_lab = Qe * tau with Qe = 1 m3/min (range 10 to 200 m3 accepted).
expected.disconfirms: A decay that is not exponential, a fitted tau far from V/Qe of any volume in 10 to 200 m3, or a Hab-B concentration that moves with the Lab's shows the one-zone hypothesis or the closed hatch does not hold; the estimate is then invalid, not corrected. A change in the number of occupants invalidates the curve.

hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone.
Exchange through the closed hatch-1-v8 is not measured (station-topology design flow 3 m3/min with hatch closed is a design figure, not assumed zero); Hab-B CO2 is recorded to show it.
The occupant count (1) and activity (awake, 0.38 L/min) are held constant during the test.

Qe at 100 percent is the datasheet effective flow 1 m3/min (0.3 single-pass efficiency times 3.3 m3/min); the scrubber lag of 3.33 min is small against tau and is excluded from the first minutes of the fit.
The rise phase of 20 min at 30 percent is far shorter than its time constant (about 100 min); it only sets the start of the decay, and tau is taken from the full-speed phase.
The total duration is capped at 60 min, so the decay phase gives about one time constant, not several.
